correctness.rationale: For every N divisible by three, independent local binomial choices give conditional triple variance 2/3 for mixed triples and zero otherwise. Uniform triple partition yields exactly k(N-k)/(N-1) mixed triples in expectation. Total conditional variance 2k(N-k)/[3(N-1)], with k or N-k conditional mean, proves the q_N quadratic moment eigenfunction. Bounded martingales and sharp finite-state H bounds imply full a.s. absorption-set entry, exact phase probabilities and matching survival-tail exponent. Exact rational enumeration at N=3,6,9 checks kernels without replacing the symbolic proof.

originality.rationale: Published earlier deterministic map identity is acknowledged as covered. The new item is the finite-N annealed, independent-per-agent Markov theorem including both neutral and reversal corners, full kernel complement duality, conditional variance, exact q_N, hitting-time exponent and phase probabilities. The inspected Galam and Toth papers do not establish that stochastic statement; general neutral martingale folklore alone does not supply its update-specific q_N.

value.rationale: The deterministic 2026 phase diagram has two special maps with no density relaxation; finite random opinion networks nevertheless must resolve stochastic consensus or alternating consensus. The theorem computes the precise finite-size diversity relaxation eigenvalue, a sharp tail exponent, exact outcome probabilities and a strong distributional complement duality, supplying a natural finite-N benchmark and separating individual from common-group contrarian implementations. It is not merely a renamed general voter-model fixation fact: the exact q_N and paired corners require this process structure.
